23f82921-fe77-471d-a5e7-e57227a2cdc2/Eve.en: The courtyard has been swept clean and bright; the blessings of the New Year seem to be gathering within.<NL>A single threshold now separates the recent toil from the winter wind and falling snow outside.
23f82921-fe77-471d-a5e7-e57227a2cdc2/Eve.cn: 院落打扫得干干净净，敞亮又清爽，新年的福气仿佛已在屋内慢慢聚拢。<NL>一道门槛，隔开了方才忙碌的身影，也挡住了岁末的寒风落雪。

23f82921-fe77-471d-a5e7-e57227a2cdc2/Opt.en: (Follow the will of heaven, and part here...)
(Stay a while longer, do not leave yet...)

f84eb205-d2a3-41ae-9a3b-f0fa39fbda80/Eve.en: No point wrestling with this biting cold any longer—I'll just shut the door and rest through the deep winter.<NL>Sweep away the clutter, clear out the dust—toss all this year's troubles out with it.<NL>Polish the windows and doorframes, and quietly wait for winter to fade and spring to return.<NL>As they say, "When the old year ends, spring draws near—cleanse the dust and welcome good cheer."<NL>With each sweep and each wipe, the room grows a little cleaner, and in turn, my heart sinks deeper into peace.
f84eb205-d2a3-41ae-9a3b-f0fa39fbda80/Eve.cn: 不再跟这凛冽的寒气较劲，索性趁着这深冬时节闭门安歇。<NL>清扫杂物、除去尘土，把一整年的烦心事都一并抛开。<NL>擦干净门窗，静静等着寒冬过去、春天到来。<NL>正所谓 “腊尽春归近，除尘待好春”。<NL>每打扫擦拭一次房间，就多得一丝清净，相应的，内心也会愈发感到安宁。

75fb4390-92f9-431f-a526-af1dd98558bc/Eve.en: Sweeping away the dust, making it fresh and new; this goodwill will be long remembered. <NL>"May the insights from driving away ill luck and attracting good fortune help you face life's future twists and turns with ease."<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> obtains trait: Sweep Haze, Welcome Might)</color>
75fb4390-92f9-431f-a526-af1dd98558bc/Eve.cn: 清扫尘埃、焕然一新，这份好意将长存于心。<NL>“希望此次驱走晦气、迎来利气的心得体会，能帮助你从容面对往后的世事波折。”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>获得特性：扫晦迎威）</color>

6d292301-8660-4e71-a20b-5937f7410faa/Eve.en: "As the old saying goes, 'If you don't Sweep the dust in the twelfth month, Ill luck follows you through the door.'<NL>Greater Cold is precisely the day to bid farewell to the old and welcome the new.<NL>I have prepared three tasks of sending away poverty and sweeping away ill luck. Doing them alone, my aura might not be enough to suppress the Ill luck.<NL>You look like someone who works efficiently; why not accompany me in arranging and cleaning, to send off the Ill luck?"
6d292301-8660-4e71-a20b-5937f7410faa/Eve.cn: “老话说，‘腊月不扫尘，晦气跟进门。’<NL>大寒本就是辞旧迎新的日子。<NL>我备了三件送穷扫晦的活儿，单凭我一人忙活，气场可能不够，镇不住这晦气。<NL>你一看便做事利落，不如陪我一起布置清扫，送走晦气？”

a409e1f9-d877-4a3d-a64b-62182a256f28/Eve.en: The table is a mess, covered with grease and scattered dishes...
a409e1f9-d877-4a3d-a64b-62182a256f28/Eve.cn: 杯盘狼藉，桌面满是油污……
a409e1f9-d877-4a3d-a64b-62182a256f28/Eve.ru: На столе беспорядок, он весь в жире и разбросанной посуде...

ebf5a90b-d1b7-4395-bf77-5f098327e632/Eve.en: The guqin table sits askew, with the instrument and score laid out carelessly...
ebf5a90b-d1b7-4395-bf77-5f098327e632/Eve.cn: 琴案斜摆，琴与谱随意摊着……
ebf5a90b-d1b7-4395-bf77-5f098327e632/Eve.ru: Стол гуцинь стоит криво, инструмент и партитура небрежно разложены...

bbb435c5-1096-4e56-881a-772b0411a030/Eve.en: Rubble and dust lie piled within the room...
bbb435c5-1096-4e56-881a-772b0411a030/Eve.ru: В комнате грудой лежат обломки и пыль...

3c96f0d7-7bb9-4704-a5ed-d03c57627618/Eve.en: (The old man trembles as he raises a hand to point)<NL>"The tables, chairs, the guqin table, and the main hall... all must be cleaned."
3c96f0d7-7bb9-4704-a5ed-d03c57627618/Eve.cn: （老人颤巍巍地抬手指点）<NL>桌椅，琴案，堂中……都得收拾。
3c96f0d7-7bb9-4704-a5ed-d03c57627618/Eve.ru: (Старик дрожащим голосом поднимает руку, указывая на что-то)<NL>"Столы, стулья, гуциньский стол и главный зал... все должно быть убрано".

3c96f0d7-7bb9-4704-a5ed-d03c57627618/Opt.en: Please point them out to me again.
3c96f0d7-7bb9-4704-a5ed-d03c57627618/Opt.ru: Пожалуйста, укажите мне на них еще раз.

75c70275-a1f1-48ce-90da-aa600cc4f22d/Eve.en: The old man takes a dustpan, gathers the dust at the doorway,<NL>walks outside and forcefully scatters it, chanting auspicious words to send away poverty.<NL>Then he takes out an Ill-luck Pouch sewn from red cloth,<NL>hands it to <主角名称>: 'This item can turn Ill luck into blessing,<NL>inside it is mixed with cinnabar and mugwort, also smoked over the vigorous fire of a brazier.<NL>Carrying it, Ill luck and the God of Poverty will not come to your door.'<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>(<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> gains trait: Sweep Ill and Welcome Prestige)</color>
75c70275-a1f1-48ce-90da-aa600cc4f22d/Eve.cn: 老人拿着簸箕，把门口的尘土收起来，<NL>走到门外用力撒出去，嘴里念着送穷吉语。<NL>接着他拿出一块红布缝制的晦气包，<NL>递给<主角名称>：“这物件能转晦气为福气，<NL>里面掺了朱砂艾叶，还用火盆的旺气熏过。<NL>带着它，晦气穷神都不会找上门来。”<NL><NL><color=#lightgrey>（<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>获得特性：扫晦迎威）</color>

6c43963f-256b-404c-8213-f39beaa0422e/Eve.en: The old man scoops up dust from the doorway with a dustpan, steps outside, and forcefully scatters it into the wind while chanting words of banishing poverty.<NL>He then turns and takes out an ill-luck pouch sewn from red cloth, handing it to <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>.<NL>"This turns misfortune into fortune. Inside are cinnabar and mugwort, refined over a fire brazier to strengthen its vitality...<NL>It drives away bad luck and keeps the spirit of poverty at bay..."
6c43963f-256b-404c-8213-f39beaa0422e/Eve.cn: 老人持簸箕将门口尘灰铲起，行至门外奋力扬出，诵念送穷之语。<NL>转身取出红布缝制的晦气包，递至<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>手中：<NL>“此为转晦为财，内掺朱砂艾叶，经火盆旺气熏制……<NL>可使晦气远避、穷神不近……”

b3ad2511-77ae-408e-8563-38442a6f4a07/Eve.en: (You feel a bold, vigorous, masculine aura envelop your body, refreshing your spirit.)<NL>(The old man claps his hands, then pats your arm with satisfaction.)<NL>"Out goes poverty and misfortune; into the hall come wealth, fortune, and longevity!"<NL>"All done! Now our home is left with nothing but cleanliness, warmth, and good luck.<NL>Go on, child—carry this 'banishing poverty' momentum with you, and your path ahead will surely land step by step in fortune's embrace!"<NL>You've gained Trait: <color=#orange>Misfortune Cleansed</color>
b3ad2511-77ae-408e-8563-38442a6f4a07/Eve.cn: （你感到一股泼辣、阳刚的气场护住周身，精神为之一振。）<NL>（老人拍拍手，又拍拍你的胳膊，一脸痛快）<NL>“穷鬼晦气送出栏，金银福寿请进堂！”​ <NL>行了，这下咱们屋里，可就只剩干净、暖和、跟好运气了！<NL>去吧孩子，带着这‘送穷’的威风，你前头的路，必定步步踩在福窝里！<NL>获得特性：<color=#orange>扫晦迎威</color>

e48f2728-a0a8-4f93-866f-aba7269810ae/Eve.en: A worn cloth bundle lies discarded in the corner, ignored by all...
e48f2728-a0a8-4f93-866f-aba7269810ae/Eve.cn: 破旧的布包袱，随意弃于墙角，无人问津……
e48f2728-a0a8-4f93-866f-aba7269810ae/Eve.ru: Поношенный матерчатый сверток лежит брошенный в углу, никем не замеченный...

46b6e847-f230-46ca-ab82-c643b12fc896/Eve.en: Past troubles will fade, and the new year will come as promised.<NL>Hands on his hips, the old man says, "Send away the poverty and welcome the fortune<NL>—that's something we do every year!"
46b6e847-f230-46ca-ab82-c643b12fc896/Eve.cn: 过去的烦恼终会离去，新年也定会如期而至。<NL>老人叉着腰说道：“送走穷气、迎来福气，<NL>这事儿咱们年年都得做！”
46b6e847-f230-46ca-ab82-c643b12fc896/Eve.ru: Прошлые неприятности забудутся, и новый год наступит, как и было обещано.<NL>Уперев руки в бока, старик говорит: "Прогони бедность и прими удачу"<NL>— это то, что мы делаем каждый год!"

dec197a7-05b6-4c2b-b6e9-bb4394e050f9/Eve.en: Places of Energy recovery—each can only be used once.
dec197a7-05b6-4c2b-b6e9-bb4394e050f9/Eve.cn: 恢复精力之处，每处仅可使用一次。
dec197a7-05b6-4c2b-b6e9-bb4394e050f9/Eve.ru: Места восстановления Энергии — каждое из них можно использовать только один раз.

dec197a7-05b6-4c2b-b6e9-bb4394e050f9/Opt.en: <color=#lightgrey>(You can no longer rest at this rest area...)</color>
dec197a7-05b6-4c2b-b6e9-bb4394e050f9/Opt.ru: <color=#lightgrey>(Вы больше не можете отдыхать в этой зоне отдыха...)</color>

3c1c6ab4-1102-4fbe-8eee-9afbb57d4fd6/Eve.en: The search is complete, and there seems to be some gain.
3c1c6ab4-1102-4fbe-8eee-9afbb57d4fd6/Eve.cn: 翻找结束，似乎有所收获······
3c1c6ab4-1102-4fbe-8eee-9afbb57d4fd6/Eve.ru: Поиск завершен, и, похоже, есть какая-то выгода.

ddf364be-17e8-476e-b504-0e3e49926d16/Eve.en: The old man sees <Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/> approaching, his eyes brightening as he gives the broom in his hand a light tap.<NL>"On a day this cold, best to stay snug indoors and keep the poverty and bad luck shut out—don't let 'em come knocking."
ddf364be-17e8-476e-b504-0e3e49926d16/Eve.cn: 老人看见<Character key=RoleTaiwu str=Name/>走来，眼睛一亮，轻轻拍了拍手里的扫帚说道：<NL>“这大寒天就该在暖屋避寒，把穷运和晦气都挡在门外，别让它们找上门来。”
